reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "no reviews yet" and then the QR lab report line. I won't put a brand with zero reviews in my cart, since I read the 1-star reviews first and need to see complaints about pill size, stomach and dosing from hundreds of people. objection: Zero reviews, so I can't check the 1-star complaints about stomach, capsule size or whether the dose is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim, not hundreds of strangers.
